text:
maria: Heads-up: scheduling a maintenance window for NVLink fabric firmware across 3 racks in us-central1. This requires a rack-level reboot + node firmware flash. Target window: Sat Apr 12 2025 02:00-06:00 UTC. We'll do a rolling drain and reboot per-rack to keep service online, but expect short drops in NVLink availability on hosts during the reboot.

aj: What's the expected capacity impact? % of GPU pool?

maria: We'll drain 3 racks (18 GPUs total) ~12% of serving capacity in us-central1. With cross-region load we expect global capacity hit ~5-8% if routing works as planned. Planning canary first 2 nodes for 30m.

ken: We need a customer comms plan for Dedicated tenants. Do we have reserved nodes we can keep for SLA customers?

maria: Good call. We'll keep 4 reserved GPUs (dedicated nodes) out of the drain so SLA traffic stays on those. CS will get an email + console banner. @support please prepare outage emails.

sophie: Can we run a quick health canary after firmware flash? i.e. run full forward pass + KV-cache warmup and verify p99 latency < 1.2x baseline before proceeding to next rack.

maria: Yes. Canary steps:
```
# drain and cordon
kubectl drain nodename --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120
# after update, run smoke test
./infra/tests/latency_smoke.sh --targets=gpu0,gpu1
```
If smoke fails, rollback firmware and mark rack healthy=false.

carl: If routing spikes, we might hit double cost. Suggest enabling short-term autoscale burst +20% for 4 hours. Estimated cloud cost ~ $600 for the window. Are we ok with that?

maria: I support burst to avoid tail latency. Ops: please set autoscaler policy to allow +20% for 04:00-08:00 UTC as a contingency.

deploy-bot: Created maintenance ticket INFRA-5342, added to calendar. Pager rotation updated.

ops-bot: Automated note: maintenance flag set -> true, console banner scheduled, health-check monitors muted during per-rack reboot window.

oncall: Who is primary pager for the window?

maria: @aj you're primary, @ken you're backup. Please be ready on Slack + phone. I'll post the final customer schedule once @support confirms email list.

aj: 👍 will be on call. I'll post a short runbook in this thread before the window.

support: Preparing email drafts now. Will push to #announcements + send to Dedicated contacts 48h before.

maria: Thanks. Final checklist before we lock window: canary script in repo, reserved nodes pinned, autoscale burst policy, CS email draft, console banner. If no objections by EOD UTC tomorrow I'll lock it.

ken: No objections from infra side. :thumbsup:

maria: OK locking window unless someone flags. :eyes:
